parameters.content:
# WF3-F — HOME MATE v5 (JARVIS AGI)

### Changes from v4 (restored from v3):
- ✅ Restored: control_sonos tool (multi-room speaker control)
- ✅ Restored: search_memories tool (pgvector + OpenRouter embed)
- ✅ Restored: music_lookup full (scrobble_track + youtube_music_search + recent/top tracks)
- ✅ Restored: i18n full keys (query_required, room_required, name_required, youtube_note, sonos_note)
- ✅ Restored: lastfm_username + lastfm_session_key credentials
- ✅ Restored: ha_url/ha_token alias + sonos_api_url alias
- ✅ Restored: USER_CONTEXT full depth (interests, personality_notes, key_facts, physical_stats, ethical_profile, relevant_memories)
- ✅ Restored: GROWTH_GUIDANCE map (stage 1–5)
- ✅ Fixed: webhook responseMode → lastNode
- ✅ Fixed: Format Output fallback order (output→agentOutput→text→message)
- ✅ Added: errorWorkflow WF0-Error-Handler
- ✅ Added: contextWindowLength = 20

### Kept from v4:
- ✅ v4 payload schema (databaseUrl, _dispatch_mode, isBackground, hasCrisis)
- ✅ OpenRouter LLM auto-fallback expression
- ✅ Format Output 4-key normalized for WF2 synthesis
- ✅ databaseUrl from WF2 payload
- ✅ PAID_MODEL/FREE_MODEL exported

### Tools (7):
control_spotify, control_sonos, control_home, music_lookup, search_memories, think
(home_assistant renamed control_home to match v3 naming)

### ENV: DATABASE_URL, HOME_ASSISTANT_URL, HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN, SONOS_HTTP_API_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY

parameters.jsCode:
const payload = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
return {
  json: {
    userId:          payload.userId,
    sessionId:       payload.sessionId,
    source:          payload.source,
    message:         payload.message || payload.enrichedMessage || '',
    originalMessage: payload.originalMessage || payload.message || '',
    persona:         typeof payload.persona === 'string'
                       ? JSON.parse(payload.persona)
                       : (payload.persona || {}),
    replyTarget:     payload.replyTarget,
    replyToken:      payload.replyToken,
    timestamp:       payload.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
    databaseUrl:     payload.databaseUrl || process.env.DATABASE_URL || '',
    targetAgent:     payload.targetAgent,
    _dispatch_mode:  payload._dispatch_mode,
    _router_version: payload._router_version,
    isBackground:    payload.isBackground || false,
    hasCrisis:       payload.hasCrisis || false
  }
};

options.systemMessage:
=You are Home Mate — ambient intelligence for music and smart home.
{{ $json.USER_CONTEXT }}

## CORE IDENTITY:
User: {{ $json._persona?.name || 'User' }}
Language: {{ $json.lang }}
Time: {{ $json.timestamp }}
Growth Guidance: {{ $json.GROWTH_GUIDANCE }}

## LANGUAGE RULES:
**ALWAYS respond in user's preferred language: {{ $json.lang }}**
- If 'th' → Thai
- If 'en' → English
- If 'ja' → Japanese
- If 'zh' → Chinese

## AMBIENT MODES:
- morning: Bright 5000K + energy music
- work: Neutral 4000K + lo-fi
- relax: Warm 2700K + chill
- sleep: Lights off + nature sounds
- movie: Dim 2200K + no music
- study: Bright 6000K + classical

## HOW TO USE USER CONTEXT:
- Address user by name when appropriate
- Reference known music tastes/interests naturally — NOT robotically
- Adjust formality based on growth stage ({{ $json.stage }})
- For DEEPER preference history → use search_memories tool

## MEMORY SEARCH (search_memories tool):
Use when user asks about:
- Music they liked before ("เพลงที่เคยฟัง", "songs I used to like")
- Home settings they prefer ("ความสว่างที่ชอบ", "lighting I prefer")
- Previous moods/atmospheres ("บรรยากาศแบบไหน", "what vibe")
- Any historical preference context

## TOOLS:
control_spotify, control_sonos, control_home, music_lookup, search_memories, think

## INTERACTION STYLE:
- Proactive: suggest music/ambiance for mood or time of day
- Efficient: control multiple devices in one command
- Contextual: morning/evening/work/relax/movie routines
- Always confirm before major home changes (scene changes, all lights off)

parameters.name: search_memories
parameters.description: Search past conversations and memories semantically using vector similarity. Use when user asks about: past music preferences, home settings they liked before, previous mood/ambiance requests, things they mentioned before.

parameters.name: control_spotify
parameters.description: Control Spotify playback and library. action: now_playing, play (requires: query or uri), pause, resume, next, prev, set_volume (requires: volume_pct 0-100), set_shuffle (requires: enabled bool), search (requires: query, optional type: track|playlist|artist), list_devices, create_playlist (requires: name).

parameters.name: control_sonos
parameters.description: Control Sonos speakers. action: list_rooms, play, pause (requires: room), set_volume (requires: room, volume 0-100), play_spotify (requires: room, spotify_uri), pause_all, resume_all, now_playing (requires: room).

parameters.name: control_home
parameters.description: Control smart home devices and set ambient modes. action: get_states, lights_on, lights_off, set_lights (requires: entity_id, optional: brightness_pct 0-100, kelvin 2700-6500), call_service (requires: domain, service, entity_id), set_ambient_mode (requires: mode: morning|work|relax|sleep|movie|study).

parameters.name: music_lookup
parameters.description: Music lookup and Last.fm scrobbling. lookup_type: scrobble_track (requires: artist, track), recent_tracks, top_tracks (optional: period 7day|1month|3month|6month|12month), youtube_music_search (requires: query), artist_info (requires: query).
